bio: Silas W. Lamoreux (1843-1909), born Lenox, Madison Co., NY; Commissioner of the General Land Office 1893-97. The 1919 book says his family came from an Orange Co. Lamoreaux family; line not traced. Others named in the 1919 book without traced descent: Rev. Rufus Lamoreaux, Andrew (Colorado legislator), Prof. Oscar F. Lamoreaux (Wheaton), Prof. Wendell Lamoreaux (Union), Judge John J. Lamoree (Oswego).
sources: A. J. Lamoureux, André Lamoureux, the Huguenot Emigrant, and Family (The Lamoureux Record no. 1, 1919): https://archive.org/details/andrlamoureuxh00lamouoft
